locator: Driving abroad; licence, insurance and national road-rule links; checked 12.06.2026
observations: Drivers must verify licence and insurance validity for every country visited.
Traffic rules, required equipment, speed, alcohol and seasonal tyre requirements vary nationally.
Vehicle registration and insurance papers should be carried and route-country requirements checked.
limitations: EU guidance does not determine recognition of a Turkish licence or insurance in a specific destination; national and transit-country authorities control.
